episodes.title: Pot O’Gold
episodes.summary: Hub Halloran starts out on an earthbound revenge story, but quickly realizes he might be in a supernatural one.

episodes.title: Valacor
episodes.summary: Hub learns more about his new job working for the devil and encounters his first demon.

episodes.title: Marphos
episodes.summary: Hub tries to turn Cade against Lucky and winds up using him for cover as he hunts another demon.

episodes.title: Erdos
episodes.summary: Maryanne, on a mission to reprimand Hub for hurting Cade, stumbles into the world of demons.

episodes.title: Slypharis
episodes.summary: Midge's emotional reason for joining Pot O' Gold comes to light. Hub puts together the pieces of a bigger mystery and tries to recruit Midge's help.

episodes.title: Revelations
episodes.summary: Lucky exacts his revenge on Hub only to be caught in a demon battle.

episodes.title: Pyralis
episodes.summary: Hub and Midge try to prevent the end times.

episodes.title: Lilith
episodes.summary: Losing the thing he loves the most, Hub is finally forced to confront his greatest sin. He sets out for a last shot at redemption by stopping a demonic force that's been unleashed from Hell.
